description: In front of you is a bed with a green sheet and a dark blue pillow, and a small bright green cloth-like item near the center. The left hand lies extended across the bed while the right hand reaches in from the right, pressing and rubbing the green cloth over the left wrist and back of the left hand; the cloth is a two-hand object as the left hand stays underneath it and the right hand moves it in short strokes and slight shifts left and right to dry the skin.
